// REQ: LANG-1161 LANG-1162 LANG-1163 LANG-1164
module Demo

open FStar.List.Tot

(* outer (* nested *) still a comment *)
type shape =
  | Circle : radius:nat -> shape
  | Rect : w:nat -> h:nat -> shape

val area : shape -> nat
let area s =
  match s with
  | Circle r -> 3 * r * r
  | Rect w h -> w * h

let rec length' (#a:Type) (l:list a) : Tot nat (decreases l) =
  match l with
  | [] -> 0
  | _ :: tl -> 1 + length' tl

let lemma_area (s:shape) : Lemma (requires True) (ensures area s >= 0) = ()

let greeting = "Hello, F*!\n"
let id' (x:'a) : 'a = x
